title: Happy 45th Birthday to the IBM PC and Model F/XT
summary: This article celebrates the 45th anniversary of the IBM Personal Computer (released in 1981) and its companion Model F keyboard, both of which were revolutionary in establishing the standard for modern personal computing. It discusses the historical significance and lasting impact of these landmark machines on the tech industry.
problem_solved: Commemorates and documents the foundational era of personal computing that shaped modern computing standards.
why_valuable: Provides historical context for understanding how the IBM PC established the template for today's personal computers and commercial software ecosystem.
